components.name: Arduino Uno

components.description: Digital humidity and temperature sensor with calibrated digital signal output for weather stations and environmental monitoring.

components.name: L298N Motor Driver

components.name: Capacitors Assortment
components.description: Electrolytic filtering capacitors (100uF 25V) and 100nF ceramic decoupling capacitors.

components.name: Integrated Circuits (DIP ICs)
components.description: Standard dual-in-line packaged integrated circuits including NE555 and ATmega328P.

components.name: TT Gearbox DC Motor

components.name: Diodes
components.description: 1N4007 / 1N4148 Silicon Rectifier and Switching Diodes for flyback protection.

components.name: Transistors
components.description: 2N2222 / BC547 NPN Bipolar Junction Transistors for amplification and electronic switching.

components.name: Raspberry Pi
components.description: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B single-board computer with 4GB RAM, Gigabit Ethernet, and dual 4K micro-HDMI.

components.name: IR Sensor
components.description: Infrared line tracker and proximity obstacle sensor module with digital TTL output.

components.name: Temperature Sensor
components.description: LM35 precision centigrade analog temperature sensor calibrated directly in Celsius.

components.name: Humidity Sensor
components.description: Capacitive environmental humidity and moisture detection module.

components.name: Stepper Motor
components.description: 28BYJ-48 5V geared 4-phase unipolar stepper motor with ULN2003 driver board.

components.name: USB Cables
components.description: Shielded USB-A to USB-B and USB-C data and programming transfer cables (1.5m).

components.name: Power Cables
components.description: Heavy-duty 14 AWG silicone DC power cables with XT60 connectors and barrel jacks.

components.name: Multimeter
components.description: Digital handheld auto-ranging multimeter with test leads, continuity buzzer, and backlit LCD.

components.name: Electronic Tools
components.description: Precision electronics tool kit containing wire strippers, flush cutters, anti-static tweezers, and bit drivers.

components.name: PCBs
components.description: Double-sided FR4 copper clad prototyping printed circuit boards (5x7cm and 7x9cm).
